prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', recommended_method='best_per_horizon_by_validation'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's directional shifts, while ONLY_CWT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.554). ONLY_CWT_rf dominates overall RMSE (10.01), but horizon specialists differ significantly—DWT_catboost excels early (6.01 RMSE) while ONLY_DWT_catboost dominates late (6.07 RMSE). High model disagreement (spread ratio 108.7) and concept drift detected suggest per-horizon selection with mixed trend/seasonality weighting.
